x: Mitcham's 4:17 miler Malcolm Burton had moved his club into 2nd place after a sprint finish with Halliday (Hercules) and Jackie Hampshire, after fighting hard all thr way with Burton, lost a little ground on the run-in but had moved Belgrave into fourth place.
And so it was that Hercules Wimbledon, through Halliday, took the lead for the very first time just yards from the tape to win the title from Reading (Bacon) by a mere second after 4 hours of racing.

Not only did Paul stand in as admin. man, he then proceeded to run a cracking 26:39 to place the team 7th after one stage with a time which puts his name right up in lights near the top of our all-time list just ahead of Gerry North and only behind Evans, Tadesse, Darren Mead, Geoff North and Halliday.
